subject: Finova decision criteria - latency, cost, deployment & SLA (follow-up)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Joe Lawson <joe.lawson@finova.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina.patel@finova.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Finova decision criteria - latency, cost, deployment & SLA (post-call recap)

Hi Joe / Nina —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the items we discussed that will influence procurement and technical evaluation: 

- Decision criteria (what matters most):
  - Latency: target p95 <= 200ms for returned generations on typical user prompt length (~150 tokens)
  - Cost: target unit economics in line with ~$0.75–1.25 per 1,000 tokens at scale (open to tradeoffs for latency/SLA)
  - Deployment: VPC/private deployment preferred for production (staging can be hosted)
  - SLA: baseline requirement 99.95% with credits & escalation path for P0 incidents
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 Type II report + encryption at rest + KMS integration are must-haves for procurement
- Buying process: procurement/legal will require the questionnaire + standard contract redlines; economic buyer is likely CFO (you indicated Nina)

Next steps I proposed on the call (see attached Finova-MAP-v1.xlsx for proposed timeline):
1) Please confirm economic buyer and procurement contacts (email and best time to get them in a joint call)
2) Confirm the latency target and whether the cost target can be a range vs fixed number
3) I'll loop in Rishi (SE) to scope a short POC plan + performance targets; Prioym from legal ops will help with contract questions

If that looks right I can share an initial SOW and an SLA draft for procurement to review.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Finova-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet - proposed milestones)

From: Joe Lawson <joe.lawson@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finova decision criteria - latency, cost, deployment & SLA (post-call recap)

Thanks Marissa — great writeup. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- Economic buyer: confirmed — Nina Patel (CFO) is the approval authority for platform spend. I'll intro her on the procurement thread once we have the questionnaire answered.
- Latency: p95 <= 200ms is our target for synchronous user-facing generation. For some background batch jobs we could tolerate higher latency but they are not in scope for the initial rollout.
- Cost: range is preferred; we're looking to keep platform spend predictable. A $0.75–$1.25 per 1k tokens range looks reasonable as a starting point, but our procurement will ask for modeled spend at 10M/month and 50M/month token volumes.
- Deployment: yes, production must be VPC/private deployment behind our VPC peering. Staging can use hosted for evaluation.
- SLA: 99.95% minimum; we'll expect a 4-hour P1 response and a dedicated escalation contact for enterprise customers.

Procurement will need: SOC 2 Type II, data retention policy, incident history for last 12 months, and a completed procurement questionnaire — sending that in a separate email (attached).

I copied Nina but will send a direct intro once we have the procurement artifact completed.

Thanks —
Joe
Director, AI Product | Finova
joe.lawson@finova.com

Attachment: Finova-Procurement-Questionnaire.pdf

Rishi — can you draft a short POC plan that tests p95 latency at ~150-token prompts and model throughput to estimate cost at 10M/50M token volumes? We can propose a 2-week perf trial on a dedicated pool so Finova can validate latency and cost tradeoffs.

Priyom — procurement will send back the questionnaire; can you confirm the right contact on our side for SOC 2 and incident history (I suggest using our compliance artifact link and the SOC2 report link in the shared doc)? Also I'll prepare an SLA draft (target 99.95%) and a sample contract redline for Nina to review.

Joe — can you share the preferred procurement timeline? If Nina is available, propose a 30-minute intro next week (I can make Tue/Wed afternoon PT) and we can walk through the questionnaire + SLA.

Thanks —
Marissa
